knownLimitations: No recipes have been imported. Aion2.gg's Terms of Use (https://aion2.gg/terms, last updated 2026-10-06) prohibit downloading its data in bulk with scripts, building datasets from it, and re-hosting its data; robots.txt disallows /api/ and /data-dump/. This project therefore does not scrape Aion2.gg.

Recipes can be added in the app (stored in your browser only) or by importing a JSON recipe pack you created or are licensed to use. Maintainers can ship a larger dataset with scripts/import-recipes.mjs once a permitted data source or written permission exists.
The Auction House fee default (10%) is a placeholder and not verified against the game.
